description: Match every invoice line to its purchase order and its goods receipt, and hold what does not agree within the tolerance you set. Choose this before releasing a supplier payment run: it decides, per invoice line, whether the amount is approved or held, and why. Do not choose this for a bank-statement reconciliation, for invoices with no purchase order, or for a PDF or scanned invoice, which needs extraction first. Example requests: Three-way match these purchase orders, receipts and invoices and tell me what to hold. | Which supplier invoices do not agree with the purchase order and the goods receipt? | Run an accounts-payable control check on this invoice file before I pay it.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

invoices.description: The customer's invoices.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns invoice_number, po_number, line, qty_billed, unit_price, currency. The invoices to check, one row per invoice line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

match_policy.description: The customer's match_policy.txt, as text. Supported: Plain text, one key=value per line: price_tolerance_pct, qty_tolerance, require_receipt. The tolerances this run applies. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

purchase_orders.description: The customer's purchase_orders.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns po_number, supplier, line, qty, unit_price, currency. The purchase orders: one row per order line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

receipts.description: The customer's receipts.csv, as text. Supported: CSV with a header row and the columns po_number, line, qty_received. What was actually received against each order line. Maximum 1048576 bytes.

inputs.title: Purchase order, receipt and invoice match

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
